Servers.// Args: Array of command-line arguments for the server
Servers.// Env: Optional environment variables for the server process (augments/overwrites inherited environment)
Servers.// Note: Set a variable to null to remove it from the inherited environment

Servers.// Example: Another MCP server with custom environment variables
Servers.Name: custom-server

Env.// Description: Environment variables are set when starting the server process (not per tool call)
